If you feel:

• You sometimes overthink situations
• You assume the worst about people
• Your mind creates stories before facts arrive
• Small misunderstandings become big conflicts

👉 This video is for you.

This is not a motivation video.

This is not a productivity hack.

This is a psychological discipline lesson.

This video tells the story of a man who loved his wife deeply…

A journey across deserts to bring her three rare apples…

A single lie…

One assumption…

And a decision that destroyed an innocent life.

Because sometimes the greatest tragedies in life are not caused by evil.

They are caused by unchecked thoughts.

🎥 WHAT YOU’LL LEARN IN THIS VIDEO

Through this powerful story from One Thousand and One Nights, you’ll discover:

✔ Why assumptions destroy relationships
✔ Why emotional reactions can ruin lives
✔ Why your thoughts are not always facts
✔ The danger of believing incomplete information
✔ How one careless lie can create massive consequences
✔ Why emotional discipline matters more than intelligence

This is not just a story.

It’s a mirror for the human mind.

🧠 THE REAL QUESTION THIS VIDEO ASKS

When something confusing happens…

Do you:

• Pause and investigate?
• Or immediately create a story in your head?

Because most people don’t suffer from reality.

👉 They suffer from the stories their mind creates.

And those stories often feel more real than truth.

📘 THE IDEAS BEHIND THIS VIDEO

This lesson connects deeply with timeless ideas from books like:

The Four Agreements

Emotional Intelligence

Extreme Ownership

Don’t Believe Everything You Think

One of the most powerful lessons from The Four Agreements is simple:

👉 Don’t Make Assumptions.

Because assumptions feel like truth.

But they are often just imagination.
